purpose: Candidate source registry for lawful free-to-watch channel discovery. A source entry is not proof that every channel or stream may be redistributed.

sources.name: IPTV-org public playlist
sources.notes: Publicly available community playlist; verify each channel, stream origin, availability, and redistribution rights before bundling.

sources.name: LyngSat Free TV directory
sources.notes: Use for FTA channel, satellite, and transponder research. Frequency data is not an internet stream and does not grant redistribution rights.

sources.name: Pluto TV
sources.notes: Free ad-supported service; availability and playback are controlled by the service and may vary by country/device. Do not extract or rehost its streams.

sources.name: Rakuten TV Live / Free
sources.notes: Official free ad-supported channels; availability varies by country and device. Do not extract or rehost its streams.

sources.name: Samsung TV Plus
sources.notes: Free ad-supported service with device and regional restrictions. Do not extract or rehost its streams.

rules: Do not mark a channel as rights-cleared solely because a stream is publicly reachable.
Do not include paid, encrypted, DRM-protected, leaked, or unauthorized streams.
Do not scrape, extract, proxy, or rehost streams from official FAST services without written permission.
Keep satellite reception data separate from internet playback URLs.
Store source attribution and review timestamps for every channel record.
Treat all external URLs and playlist metadata as untrusted input.
